description: Search UK planning applications by keyword, council, postcode, status, type, or date range. Returns matching applications with address, description, reference, status, and dates. Use for questions like 'recent planning applications in Camden' or 'refused extensions in OX1'.

limit.description: Results per page (paid keys up to 100; free keys 10).

postcode.description: Postcode or postcode prefix, e.g. 'OX1' or 'SW1A 1AA'.

q.description: Full-text search across address, description, and reference.

name: search_planning_applications
